name: IGNITER
source:
Toka and Natsume, who live in the Fire Dragon's territory, reach adulthood on an island of beastmen ruled by dragon.
In accordance with customs passed down from generation to generation in the area, they must visit the Baby Dragon's Den in the eastern forest.
However, a glimpse of something strange happening on this island was happening there.

[From [url=https://bl-s21.itch.io/igniter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活在火龙领地的十香和夏目在龙统治的兽人岛上长大成人。
按照当地世代相传的习俗，他们必须去东部森林里的幼龙巢穴看看。
然而，这座岛上却发生了一些奇怪的事情。

[来自[url=https://bl-s21.itch.io/igniter]Itch.io[/url]]
